payload.rebuttal: fixed: The docstring's 'All three read a recorded spec text' was wrong: only the inline case (case_c) calls ledger.record_spec_text. Cases A and B (the pinned-commit and no-commit-pinned cases) declare the witness directly in the fixture's base spec file and read it through the ordinary base-export path, with ledger.spec_text(task_id) returning None for them. I reworded the docstring to say the first two cases read the base export's own spec file and only the third reads a recorded text declaring its mutant inline.
